Package domain

Class BracketMatch

java.lang.Object
domain.BracketMatch
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class BracketMatch extends Object implements Serializable
A match of the tournament bracket: which two teams play it, in which round, and how it ended. It is not played on screen: the match of the player gets the result of the real Match, and the matches between two machines are simulated.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda

    • simulate

      public void simulate(Random random)
      Gives a random result to a match between two machines (from 0 to 3 goals each). It never ends in a tie: on a tie, one more goal goes to a random side.
      Parameters:
      random - decides the goals
